head: Which iPhones get the full Apple Intelligence and Siri AI in iOS 27
dek: The full set, including Siri voice options, needs 12 GB of memory: iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone Air, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, MacDailyNews reports; iPhone 15 Pro, the iPhone 16 line and iPhone 17 get the base features, and the regular iPhone 15 and older get none.
